sourcePolicy: Official ISM monthly reports are authoritative. This stores aggregate diffusion data and selected public respondent comments only; no confidential/raw submissions are claimed.

manufacturing.powerStackInterpretation: Orders, production, employment and backlog strengthened while customer inventories remained too low. Electrical/electronic expansion and component scarcity support equipment pricing power; high prices/slower deliveries remain contractor execution risks.

services.powerStackInterpretation: Business Activity/New Orders accelerated while Prices exceeded 70 and Employment contracted. Switchgear, transformers, wire/cable and technical labour remain direct infrastructure bottlenecks.

respondentCommentReview.scope: Only ISM-selected public respondent comments and aggregate diffusion data reviewed.
respondentCommentReview.finding: Re-verified Aug 28. July remains latest official Manufacturing and Services dataset. The July Manufacturing roundup explicitly notes the AI boom/data-centre buildup as a current uncertainty; aggregate July evidence remains supportive for electrical/electronic demand and scarcity. No confidential/raw respondent access is claimed.

combinedRead: Constructive for Power Stack physical demand but not cleanly disinflationary. Prefer backlog-rich generation/grid/electrical/cable and commercial automation suppliers with pricing power over low-margin contractors and long-duration concept equities, especially after the Aug 28 rate repricing.
